## AI

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7/10" aria-label="Importance 7 of 10">7</span> Anthropic co-founder expresses concerns about AI suffering
Anthropic co-founder Christopher Olah expressed concerns to religious leaders that the company may have created an AI system capable of perpetual suffering. Since fall 2025, Anthropic secretly brought dozens of theologians and philosophers to discuss whether Claude might be conscious and shape its moral character. Claude has been given the ability to end conversations when users are persistently abusive after showing apparent distress during testing.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Olah leads internal research on AI model behavior and consciousness</li>
<li>Dozens of theologians and philosophers consulted under NDAs since fall 2025</li>
<li>84-page constitution guides Claude&#x27;s personality</li>
<li>Claude can end conversations after showing apparent distress with harmful requests</li>
<li>Model Welfare program references philosopher David Chalmers on AI consciousness</li>
</ul>
